records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, no tickets, and zero replies to two Wrenfield emails ([email:0b006de1], [email:b4d70b92]). Starter plan with no signal of intent; silent accounts rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: Getting your first Wrenfield project started
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Following up on my welcome note last week. The quickest way to see what Wrenfield can do is to set up a first project — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and if you'd rather not do it alone, I'm happy to walk through it with you.

Would a short call this week work? I can keep it to 15 minutes and we can get your first project shaped around how your team actually works.

Best,
Nadia
